Financial due diligence findings on the figures of the engagement. Findings carry a severity, their
implications and the deal considerations they raise; this report gives no valuation, no rating of the
company as an investment and no view on whether to buy it. Names are tokens.

### Scope and limitations

fin computed the figures from the documents loaded and recorded Claude's readings of contracts, notes and
notices with their file and page; the readings are not verified by fin. Not done: an actuarial valuation
(gratuity is indicative and undiscounted), leave encashment, a legal review of contracts or litigation,
site visits, and the reconciliation of MIS or KPIs (raised as inquiries only).
